about.headline: Built for the ones
about.heroBody: Every Mipador Accessories piece starts with the same question: does this earn a place in someone's daily life for years, not seasons? Honest materials and quiet craft, based in Casablanca. For people who take detail seriously.
about.storyP1: Mipador Accessories started with a simple observation: the pieces we'd come to trust most had nothing to do with how much they cost. A field watch that survived a decade of daily wear. A leather tote that only got better with use. A pair of sunglasses that never scratched, wear after wear.
about.storyP2: They had something harder to name — reliability. Every material chosen because it held up. Every finish chosen because it earned its place. Every piece built to be worn for years, not replaced by the season.
about.storyP3: Just the feeling of a piece that does its one job, perfectly, for years, without ever asking you to think about it.
about.quote: "A good accessory doesn't ask for attention. It just refuses to let you down."
about.quoteAttrib: — A belief we build every piece around
about.quoteResponse: Most brands try to sell you more than you need. We just try to make what you already reach for, better.
about.manifesto: Mipador Accessories exists for the people who are done with hype drops and fake urgency. Buy less. Choose materials that actually hold up. Choose a piece because it earns its place — not because a countdown timer told you to. Not to impress. Not to perform. Just to last.

vision.p1Body: Every detail earns its place — no more, no less. That precision is the soul of Mipador Accessories. Not a brand built on hype drops. Not a brand built on fake scarcity. A brand built on the certainty that something made correctly, once, keeps being right for years.
vision.p2Lead: We design for people who live that way.
vision.p2Body: Pieces that earn their place not through price tags or trend reports, but through honesty — the right material chosen properly, the right finish sitting quietly, the right detail that makes you look twice. Watches, sunglasses, jewelry, bags, scarves, belts, hats. Made to last, not to be replaced.
vision.p3Lead: Mipador Accessories is for those who move with purpose.
vision.p3Body: Who know the difference between an accessory that impresses and one that simply holds up honestly — and only want the second kind. Based in Casablanca, Morocco. Delivered wherever you are.

modelGrid.eyebrow: The moments we're built for shape what we make
modelGrid.heading: Where does Mipador Accessories go?
modelGrid.body: From the 6 AM flight to the meeting that runs long to the dive you've been planning all year — we build for moments that actually happen.

coreFeatures.heading: Three principles.
coreFeatures.value1Desc: Nothing we make is accidental. Every material, every finish, every detail is chosen because it earns its place.
coreFeatures.value2Desc: Movements regulated and tested before they ever reach a wrist. Case backs, crowns, and clasps built by people who understand tolerances measured in microns.
coreFeatures.value3Desc: We build things that still keep perfect time years later. Real movements inside, cases that age gracefully, and a warranty that means what it says.

seo.title: Find Your Match — Style Finder
seo.desc: Not sure what fits you? Pick a style and get matched with watches, eyewear, jewelry, and more from Mipador Accessories — free, instant, no sign-up.

hero.heading: Which look is actually you?
hero.body: Six ways to put yourself together. Pick the one that sounds like your week, and we'll match you with the pieces built for it — across every category.

voyager.name: The Voyager
voyager.desc: For the ones who live between time zones — a GMT watch that tracks home while you're anywhere but, aviators built for long runways, and a tote that carries a trip's worth of things without complaint. Chosen by people who measure a trip by how little they had to think about it.
voyager.wearOffice: The GMT slides under a cuff without announcing itself.
voyager.wearWeekend: Aviators and a tote — pack light, move fast.
voyager.wearEvening: A steel bracelet and clean lenses read formal enough for dinner at altitude.
voyager.mantra: Time is relative. Yours shouldn't be.

executive.name: The Executive
executive.tagline: Quiet enough to be the loudest thing in the room.
executive.desc: A thin dress watch, rectangle frames, a reversible belt that never announces itself twice. For people whose look is the last thing they think about before a meeting — because it was chosen once, correctly, years ago.
executive.wearOffice: Disappears under a blazer, exactly as intended.
executive.wearWeekend: Doesn't ask for a day off.
executive.wearEvening: The one combination black tie won't question.

diver.name: The Diver
diver.tagline: Built for the deep end of the day.
diver.desc: 200 meters of water resistance, wayfarers that don't flinch in salt spray, and a crossbody built to survive a beach day. For people who don't take their gear off to swim, shower, or think twice.
diver.wearOffice: A rubber strap under a rolled sleeve says you have somewhere better to be after six.
diver.wearWeekend: This is the whole reason it exists.
diver.wearEvening: Swap to a NATO strap and it still holds its own.
diver.mantra: Tested against depth, not a spec sheet.

racer.name: The Racer
racer.desc: Contrast sub-dials, a tachymeter bezel, and a leather belt built with the same no-nonsense hardware. For people who like gear that does something, not just looks the part.
racer.wearOffice: Reads as sharp, not sporty, under a blazer.
racer.wearEvening: A panda dial photographs better than most jewelry.
racer.mantra: Built to time things that matter.

purist.name: The Purist
purist.desc: An open-worked movement, round frames, a single-stone pendant, a silk scarf with nothing printed on it that doesn't need to be there. For people who'd rather look twice than be told once. Not for everyone — that's exactly the point.
purist.wearOffice: A conversation starter you didn't have to start.
purist.wearWeekend: Winding it is the ritual, not a chore.
purist.wearEvening: Gunmetal and gold read formal under low light.
purist.mantra: Winding it is part of the wearing.

wanderer.name: The Wanderer
wanderer.desc: Legible, tough, and priced so you never flinch when it gets scratched. A cap and a wool scarf built for whatever the day throws at them. For people whose gear should survive the day, not just decorate it.
wanderer.wearOffice: Understated enough not to compete with a lanyard.
wanderer.wearEvening: Swap to leather and it cleans up fine.
wanderer.mantra: The day doesn't ask permission. Neither should you.
